page.layout: One page of a scriptural index in two parallel columns of tables, headed "INDEX LOCORUM" across the top; the left column (Cap. | Verf. | Pag.) and the right column (Cap. | Verf. | Pag.) read top to bottom. A catchword-like mark "Cap." sits at the lower right below the right column. The Google digitiser watermark at the bottom right is not transcribed.
page.notes: The scan is faded and blurred at the top and in places down the columns; some page numbers and verse entries (notably 1001, 1010, 872.996, 975) are uncertain. The "ult." entries may read "ult." or "Ult." in the printed hand. The lower-right mark "Cap." is a printed catchword-like tag. The left column's first row "Cap. | Verf. | Pag." is a header line, and the "Josua", "Judic.", "Ruth.", "I. Sam." and "II. Samuel." labels are book headings rendered as lines, not transcribed as division heads.
